## What it is

Developer docs under `platform/dev/<version>/`, merchant docs under `platform/func/`, hubs under `platform/hubs/`.

## How to navigate

1. grep the term in the version directory.
2. If nothing hits, grep `platform/synonyms.md`.
3. Then read the hub index.
